description: OSM Building Footprints Vector Tiles Dataset – Dominica, 2025 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abdulaziz Yusuf Ali (University of Twente). Demonstration Case Name Multihazards in the Caribbean SIDS Dataset Title OSM Building Footprints Vector Tiles Dataset – Dominica, 2025 Dataset Description This dataset consists of vector tiles containing OpenStreetMap building footprints, processed using Planetiler. The MBTiles format stores geometric representations of buildings as vector data, enabling efficient rendering and analysis within digital twin environments. Coverage: national (DM); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
